name: Melakuera
description: Melakuera was the Arbitrator and a former member of the Four Great Spirits, serving as the Great Spirit of Fire before being succeeded by Puck. Viewing Emilia's physical resemblance to the Witch of Envy as an unforgivable sin, he sought to exterminate her in Elior Forest seven years prior to the start of the main story, leading to his defeat and destruction by Puck in the clash known as the Day of Red Earth and Sky.
